findings.description: The status window rejects only outside 100-599, so the `100` becomes the client's response: `HTTP/1.1 100 Error`, `Content-Length: 0`, `Connection: keep-alive` (reason phrase is the generic `Error`). The body is still re-parsed and executed 2/2, so the client receives a success-shaped head with no body and cannot distinguish it from a real one. Same precondition as the other interim findings: a proxy location and a 100-emitting upstream.
findings.title: This build accepts 1xx as terminal, relays `100 Error` to the client as the whole response, and executes the body as a second request

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
